noticias.titular: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview adds MCP so AI agents can create 3D environments
noticias.entradilla: Epic Games has released a preview version of the engine with AI features, all of them experimental.
noticias.imagen_alt: A terminal labelled “Agent” and a cube labelled “3D editor” joined by a double-headed arrow labelled “MCP”; beneath the cube, a red zigzag line and the label “Experimental”.

noticias.titular: A test with three models suggests that drawing in SVG avoids errors in science diagrams
noticias.entradilla: A teacher asked three advanced models for a diagram of an animal cell. None made content errors, and they put the reliability down to the vector format.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of two paths starting from “Model”: one goes through “SVG code” and reaches an animal cell with a tick; the other goes through “Generator” and reaches another cell without one.

noticias.titular: A second video with Fable 5.2 adds an agent that checks the scientific content before generating it
noticias.entradilla: After the photosynthesis animation, the same teacher has made one on cellular respiration with a reviewing agent, and has translated the first into Catalan.
noticias.imagen_alt: A chain of five steps with arrows, labelled “Script”, “Reviewer”, “Images”, “Reviewer” and “Video”, with a magnifying glass at each review step.

noticias.titular: “Polvo eres”, a stop-motion animated short made with generative AI
noticias.entradilla: A member of the group has shared their first short film, a spoof of cute horror made with generative AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three consecutive frames of a stop-motion short in which a little dust monster moves from left to right; labels: “Stop-motion”, “Little dust monsters” and “AI-generated”.

noticias.titular: A single sentence is enough for Fable 5.2 to produce a photosynthesis animation for sixth-form students
noticias.entradilla: With a single prompt, the model produced a square video with a natural voice aimed at sixth-form students. The author considers it good enough for class and speaks of a new way to create materials.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a message bubble labelled “One prompt” leads to a box with the console symbol labelled “Console”, which leads to a square screen with a leaf labelled “Square video”; above, a red clock labelled “45 min”.

noticias.titular: How “Buzz” was shot: Claude, Blender via MCP, a virtual reality headset and Seedance
noticias.entradilla: Its director details the process behind the short film the paper covered yesterday, and warns that it is expensive in credits.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four steps in a row joined by arrows: a code document labelled “App with Claude”, a 3D cube labelled “Blender and MCP”, a headset labelled “Filming in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Seedance”; a red arrow points at the last one with the label “Costly in credits”.

noticias.titular: A short film is shot inside virtual reality and finished with AI
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres shares a preview of “Buzz”, a short film whose shots he directs with a virtual reality headset on sets created in Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in three steps joined by arrows: a 3D set labelled “Set in Blender”, a virtual reality headset labelled “Camera in VR” and a clapperboard labelled “Final with AI”. Below, in a dashed box, what is still to come: “Colour, sound, editing”.

noticias.titular: Google Flow charges credits per second for Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash videos
noticias.entradilla: Flow’s official help page sets out the cost of generating and editing clips with the model, which can already be chosen in the app, according to comments in the group.
noticias.imagen_alt: Chart with two bars: the short one, labelled “360p”, has “1 credit/s” above it and the tall one, labelled “720p”, has “3 credits/s”. On the right, a film clapperboard and, beneath some coins, the label “50 a day”.

noticias.titular: Google unveils Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which generates and edits videos of up to 15 seconds
noticias.entradilla: The new version of Google’s video model extends clip length and allows clips to be refined over several turns. The announcement was shared in EduMedia-IAG.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two bars compare duration: “Omni 1.1: 10 s” and, longer, “Omni 1.2: 15 s”. Below, three video cameras joined by arrows labelled “Turn by turn” show the clip being refined step by step, and a tag labelled “SynthID” marks the output.

noticias.titular: A tool turns a mobile phone and VR headset into a virtual camera for Blender
noticias.entradilla: Raül Torres describes how, with help from Claude, he built a system that records real camera movements in Blender to then guide an AI video generator.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three-step diagram from left to right: a phone with a red dot and the label REC, under the caption “Phone or headset”; an arrow to a 3D cube with a camera at the end of a dotted path, under the caption “Blender scene”; and another arrow to a video frame with a landscape, under the caption “AI video”.

noticias.titular: A teacher recommends building infographics in HTML and SVG rather than as generated images
noticias.entradilla: A member of Vibe Coding Educativo argues that, to illustrate concepts, AI should generate SVG shapes and icons in an HTML page, with generated images kept for when they are pedagogically necessary.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in which an “Idea” splits into two paths: one ends in a crossed-out opaque block, the “Generated image”, and the other in an infographic of shapes and icons, “HTML and SVG”, from which two advantages branch off: “Screen reader” and “Light and dark”.

noticias.titular: A website gathers motion-graphics videos with their prompts and skills for agents
noticias.entradilla: MotionVideo offers AI-made videos accompanied by their prompts, and skills that teach a coding agent how to do motion design.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three boxes linked by arrows: a written prompt, a skill shaped like a terminal window, and a video with a play button and a red motion path beneath it.

noticias.titular: An AI-made horror web series documents its workflow step by step
noticias.entradilla: “Never Sleep Again”, seven episodes released between 25 and 31 October, explains on its website how it combines Blender, Claude, a video generator and DaVinci Resolve.
noticias.imagen_alt: Horizontal diagram in five steps: “3D house”, a house modelled in 3D; “Reference”, a grey clip showing the camera path; “AI video”, the video generation; “Review”, with an arrow looping back; and “Editing”, a timeline; below, a human figure connected to every step.
